# LoadedIngredient

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Formats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public class LoadedIngredient : IDisposable
```

An ingredient manifest paired with its eagerly-decoded variant images. \*\*Owns those images\*\*: dispose it (or the recipe/cookbook above it) to free them.

### Depths { #p-depths }

```csharp
public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, DepthMap> Depths { get; init; }
```

Per-pixel front/back depth maps, keyed by variant id. A variant with no entry here is flat — "paper" — for the Rise feature. May cover every variant, although variants without painted depth need no entry.

## Methods

### Dispose() { #m-dispose }

```csharp
public void Dispose();
```

Frees every image this object owns. Reading an archive eagerly decodes them all, so this is how a caller gives them back.
